---
title: Pitfalls — File Formats
---

## JPEG compression artifacts

Lossy compression can blur fine vessel details. Use lossless formats (PNG, TIFF) for intermediate storage when possible.

## DICOM tag pitfalls

- `BitsStored` vs. `BitsAllocated`: the actual data depth may be less.
- `PhotometricInterpretation`: MONOCHROME1 vs. MONOCHROME2 affects display.
- Transfer syntax (compressed vs. uncompressed) determines whether pixel data is directly accessible.

## Vendor format lock-in

Heidelberg `.e2e` and similar may require proprietary SDKs for full functionality. Prefer converting to DICOM or open formats for long-term accessibility.
